records.latest_ai_summary: Group road cycling across the rolling hills of Leicester and Alexander, with 26- and 33-mile route options paced at 15–19 mph for experienced riders seeking an evening training ride.
records.description_excerpt: Thursday Road Ride from Youngblood Bicycles From Youngblood Bicycles: We have a road ride that leaves from the shop every Thursday evening at 6PM, weather permitting and during Daylight Savings Time. The A and B routes are about 33 and 26 miles respectively through the rolling hills of Leicester / Alexander. The A pace is about 18-19 mph and B about 15-17 mph.
